profile.headline: Software Engineer at Aurora
profile.summary: Graduated from the Robotic Institute from Carnegie Mellon University, Dung-Han (Michael) is enthusiastic about SLAM and AR/VR/XR. He would love to share his passion with anyone interested and discuss any possible opportunities!

positions.title: Research Software Engineer - Localization
positions.description:
• Design and implemented vehicle velocities estimation, using fix-lag smoother, C++ and GTSAM
 • Implemented online wheel calibration using Levenberg–Marquardt batch optimization, enabling better speed estimation and control
• Improve the robustness of localization module by simulating sensory failures, conducting experiments and adjusting robust noise kernels/noise parameters

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern, Sensor Systems
positions.description:
•	Designed and developed a real-time RGB-D human position tracking algorithm for security
system using C++, sparse point cloud computation and Intel RealSense RGB-D camera
 •	Researched and developed algorithms for access control using 3D curvature analysis and C++,  achieving 90% precision and recall performance at 10 FPS
 •	Implemented live demonstrations connecting hardware, algorithms, and GUI output.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Performed transfer learning and hard case mining for VGG-16 neural network using Caffe and Python, increasing the gender classification accuracy on surveillance cameras from 90% to 93.6%

certifications.name: Master of Science of Robotic Systems Development
certifications.title: Master of Science of Robotic Systems Development

volunteerExperiences.description:
●Learned Indonesian and promoted traditional dramas by public perfoming at city hall. 
●Cooperated with an international team which consist of members of 7 different countries

projects.title: LIDAR frontier-based exploration
projects.description:
• Implemented frontier-based exploration using C++ and PCL, enabling a robot to explore unknown space using raw LIDAR pointcloud 
• Implemented ROS integration code for easy robot integration

projects.title: LIDAR-based navigation with RIUNet
projects.description:
• Trained a RIUNet using Python and Pytorch, enabling LIDAR-based in-row navigation with 79% IOU and a 96% success rate on test data 
• Implemented conversion between range-images and pointclouds, as well as their visualization functions

publications.title: Graph-Based Topological Exploration Planning in Large-Scale 3D Environments
publications.publisher: International Conference on Robotics and Automation · Jun 3, 2021

organizations.name: AIESEC Taiwan
organizations.description:
•	Selected as the representative of AIESEC Taiwan to participate in the Asia Pacific Leaders Summit in Bangkok, Thailand in 2015
•	Raised the program sales ranking to top 1 in North Taiwan by analyzing sales data of last two years, redesigning functional education, and cooperating with international partners 
•	Led a sales team of 10 members to contract with 11 Taiwanese companies, and delivered six international interns to Taiwanese companies in the first season
